title: Authentication & App Shell
notes: Login/forgot/reset/setup exist and now use ds-* tokens instead of raw green/red/amber Tailwind colors. Fixed a real bug: login (password + OTP) was discarding the real Tenant from the login response and fabricating a fake partial one via `as any` — now uses response.data.tenant directly. Sessions page (settings/sessions) rebuilt onto PageHeader + DataTable + EmptyState + Skeleton + useConfirm (was raw Card/Table with no confirm-before-revoke); it's a small flat array from the backend (not paginated), so no infinite scroll/filterBar apply here — ListPage archetype doesn't fit a non-paginated dataset. Help page's 'Contact Support' form posted to a nonexistent `/api/support-tickets` Next.js route (this app has no Next API routes at all, only the Workers backend) — replaced with a copy-to-clipboard + direct support-email instruction since no such backend endpoint exists in this slice and mailto: is banned. Sidebar badge counts are already wired to notificationsApi.getBadgeCounts() with realtime updates, not hardcoded as previously noted. Shell (sidebar/topbar/command palette) was already solid, uses shadcn CSS-var classes consistently (not raw hex/px, so contract-compliant) — left as-is rather than a wholesale ds-* rewrite given no functional defect.
showcaseScript: Open the app and sign in with email and password
Show the tenant-aware sidebar and global search
Open Settings → Sessions and revoke another device
Sign out and confirm the login screen returns
